overview.title: Watchtowers and Cliff Trails
overview.p1: Torres de Alcalá offers historic coastal watchtowers and trails with open views over Rif cliffs and the Mediterranean.
overview.p2: Short sections are moderate; exposure and uneven ground matter more than distance. Morning light and cooler air are best.
overview.p3: Pairs well with Cala Iris or Bades Bay on a longer park-coast day with a driver who knows the road.

q1.question: Is it a difficult walk?
q1.answer: Some sections are moderate because of exposure and uneven ground more than distance.

q2.question: Good for children?
q2.answer: Yes for short, safe sections with supervision. Avoid exposed edges with young children.

q3.question: Best time?
q3.answer: Morning for soft light and cooler air. Late afternoon gives warm colours on the cliffs and sea.

q4.question: Do I need a guide?
q4.answer: Not mandatory on clear paths, but a local guide or driver makes access easier.

q5.question: Combine with Bades?
q5.answer: Yes. Many visitors pair Torres de Alcalá with Bades Bay or Cala Iris on one park-coast day.
